prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "Select your journey path"]
1: ["Sign In to Secure Your Pet Companion", "Keep your pet saved securely across sessions and prevent progress loss.", "Cloud Protection Active", "Sign in with your account to maintain continuous pet access."]
2: ["Preview Your Desktop Companion", "Review your pet appearance before signing the official certificate.", "Confirm Adoption"]
3: ["Setting Up Desktop Pet Workspace", "Initializing graphics and behavior engines...", "Desktop pets hang out around open windows when active."]
4: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Complete these quick steps to start interacting with your pet on screen.", "Right-click pet to open context menu", "Press shortcut to hide or show pet anytime", "Click pet directly to initiate dialogue"]
5: ["Select Your Journey (Takes 1 Minute)", "Pick an instant pet template or build a custom desktop friend.", "You can change pet styles anytime later from options."]
6: []
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Seal", "Official Adoption Certificate"]
8: ["Preparing Desktop Pet", "You can keep working. We will send a system alert when your companion lands on your desktop!"]
9: ["Onboarding Complete! Here is Your Starter Pack", "Unlocked: Golden Desk Toy"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or gifts (starter pack and unlocked item).
